description: Series style and score-generation settings. Eligible book slugs and titles are derived from books/series.json and validated against each book.json.

duration.rule: Each cover/page narration duration plus hold is rounded up to a whole 24fps frame.

generation.negative_prompt: No vocals, no speech, no sound effects, no sudden fills, no key changes, no loud percussion.

castle-everstair.name: The Castle Everstair Stories
castle-everstair.style: Felt piano with gentle legato strings
castle-everstair.prompt: Tender magical storybook instrumental, intimate felt piano lead with soft sustained legato strings and a few delicate harp-like notes, warm moonlit wonder, gentle curiosity, slow graceful motion, lots of open space for a parent reading aloud, soft dynamics, no vocals, no percussion, no dramatic swells, no cartoon sparkle.

arrangements.description: Sparse felt piano and one soft string line; leave generous space around the piano.
A gentle piano figure with a warm cello undercurrent; the arrangement unfolds quietly.
Lightly hopeful piano and tender strings; settle into a soft, resolved close.

ruby-and-the-dragon-bonds.style: Nylon-string guitar, felt piano and soft woodwinds
ruby-and-the-dragon-bonds.prompt: Warm intimate children's story instrumental, gentle nylon-string guitar picking with soft felt piano and occasional mellow woodwind color, tender and curious, natural unhurried phrasing, welcoming and emotionally safe, roomy arrangement beneath spoken reading, no vocals, no drums, no jaunty folk bounce, no dramatic swells.
